person_note: The controlling narration is third person. Numerous interior Goodreads passages externally narrate Reacher and other characters, including their thoughts and actions, while authorized opening and interior excerpts independently show the same structure across both major plot strands. Dialogue, the gnomic generic-you quote, and probable promotional synopsis text are non-base material; two clipped passages remain locally unresolved but provide no credible first- or second-person counterevidence. The only remaining uncertainty concerns those isolated quote boundaries, not the book-level narrative person.
